verdict.rationale: The founder describes Zero as letting users "chat with their inbox", and the repo describes it as AI-driven with Agents & LLMs. MCP.md lists natural-language capabilities such as asking questions about mailbox content and composing with AI assistance. However, the evidence shows mainly Q&A and drafting, not documented in-app natural-language commands that perform actions (archive, label, delete); those actions are exposed only as MCP tools behind session-cookie auth, which is a prose list with no schema. missing for 10: documented in-app natural-language command execution for mailbox actions, depth/limits of the chat interface, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
